checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block. Occupant-controlled curtain dressing is a separate physical layer behind the repeated manufactured sash, with 30 deterministic assemblies, physical LOD0 pleats and LOD0/1/2/3 staging.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging; the apartment curtain layer independently uses four cross-faded LOD levels so close pleats are not paid at distance.

Root/trunk/branch/twig/leaf hierarchy tooling exists; tree anchors also receive root-zone planting interfaces rather than remaining visually disconnected from the plaza/grass substrate. Static clone-risk QA normalizes tree roots and rejects exact render-hierarchy duplicates among simultaneously active generated fallbacks.

Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present, with measured-order dielectric F0/GGX constraints and explicit QA. Cause-based understory uses the same thin-leaf optical model and four renderer-distinct cross-faded LOD levels with density reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as non-colliding source-anchored meshes; vegetation density likewise follows ordinary maintenance/foot-traffic pressure rather than random decoration.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, dry non-metallic weathering residue materials, root-zone soil/precast tree-pit materials, transmitted-light foliage, park/street-furniture PBR sets, and curtain-fabric families with textile normal/albedo structure. Active map registration/sampling and actual scene material metallic/specular ranges have dedicated QA.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing and BlendProbesAndSkybox. The authoritative pre-capture path now retains RenderIDs, yields to later EditorApplication.update callbacks, requires IsFinishedRendering(RenderID)=true plus created 512px Cube realtimeTexture, and writes both the runtime completion receipt and a fresh SHA-256-bound async-wait proof before benchmark Camera.Render is allowed.

Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics and occupancy variation skip when the danchi authored-art slot is active. Vegetation ecology keys from stable tree-slot anchors, so authored tree replacement does not require moving the surrounding root-zone interface.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with foundation/grade, facade/glazing, apartment window dressing, environment, reflection synchronization, facade-weathering, vegetation-ecology, scene-repetition and park/street-furniture contracts. Metadata records manufacture, dimensions, mounting, clearances, albedo/roughness/metallic/F0/normal/microstructure/wetness/UV aging/angular response, geometry-vs-material split and LOD policy where applicable.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before reflection synchronization. The complete review packet then requests both realtime cubemaps, returns control to the Editor, polls completion on later Editor updates, SHA-256 binds the async-wait proof to the exact completion receipt, and only then captures without rebuilding the scene. CapturePreparedSceneAfterProbeSync requires the wait proof, so the legacy synchronous path fails closed rather than becoming authoritative evidence.

Capture contract records exact hero/oblique/grazing view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it. Reflection synchronization has a runtime completion receipt plus a separate fresh async-wait proof hash-bound to that receipt rather than relying on the manifest Boolean or a same-call-stack RenderProbe check. No static check is allowed to clear a critical visual defect.

latestRun.verification: GitHub source/static inspection plus current Unity 6 API documentation review only. The previous synchronization hardened RenderProbe completion but still checked IsFinishedRendering immediately in the same call stack. Unity 6 documentation returns a RenderID from RenderProbe and demonstrates IsFinishedRendering from later Update calls; NoTimeSlicing means the probe is rendered in one frame, not that the RenderProbe method call itself is a completed rendering frame. This pass makes the authoritative Native 4K Review Packet asynchronous across EditorApplication.update callbacks, requests PlayerLoop/SceneView progression, uses a 30s fail-closed timeout, requires created 512x512 Cube realtimeTexture, writes the normal completion receipt, then writes a separate wait proof containing poll count/elapsed time/RenderIDs and the SHA-256 of that exact completion receipt. The proof must be current Unity/current scene, at least one later Editor poll and <=2 minutes old before still capture. CapturePreparedSceneAfterProbeSync itself requires the proof, so the legacy direct synchronous route cannot produce authoritative frames. No Unity runner exists on this branch: current commit-status contexts and workflow runs are absent, and no Assets/QA/Captures4K directory is present. Therefore this remains source-side evidence-integrity hardening only; no render-quality claim or Visual Fidelity points are awarded.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Lighting/shadows/reflections: prevents hero/oblique/grazing evidence from being accepted against a merely-requested or stale realtime reflection cubemap when Unity has not yet advanced the probe-rendering frame.

Material/PBR physical plausibility: makes glass Fresnel, aluminum/galvanized-metal highlights and wetness/specular review correspond to the exact current sky/sun/geometry state rather than an earlier cubemap.
Cinematic image quality: keeps highlight energy and exposure diagnostics tied to the actual synchronized reflection environment; synchronization itself still earns zero image-quality points.

Critical evidence integrity: same-call-stack RenderProbe completion can no longer become authoritative sealed still evidence through the official review packet, and the final Camera.Render requires a fresh SHA-256-bound async wait proof.
